title: Chrono Trigger

obj._why: the game fills a party palette's unused slots 13-15 with other colours in the field (Crono: ObjPlt_0000 colours 0-12 + 3 extra), so the byte key's palette hash never matches; the colour key hashes only the colours the sprite shows

twod._pairs_why: NPC sheets share palettes, chosen per NPC by the game (not a table found in the ROM); these pairings were seen in play (2026-10-03, Crono's room and house)

notes: Sprites only (22670 sprite images, 85% of them character sheets under Chara/). The game has no 3D textures and no NFTR fonts.

Field and town backgrounds are not in the pack. They are the SNES port's format: Map/Bg/Bg_*_ncg.bin tile sets and BgPlt_*_ncl.bin palettes (11 rows of 16 colours), laid out at runtime from PS_BIN/ChipTable (16x16 chips) and PS_BIN/MapTable (maps, compressed). Without parsing those the tool cannot tell which palette row a tile uses, so it has no key for it.

verified.on_device: AYN Thor: 54754 entries indexed; title logo sprites 2580/2640 lookups hit. Intro movie, pendulum and field BGs stay native (not in the pack).
